Based on the intent for described requirements - I would say that your concern should be covered by existing requirements - 14.1.1, 14.1.2 + 14.2.3, so I think we don't need a new requirement.

One option is to point out more clearly in 14.2.3, that for each type of data that it must leak to un**authorized** party for that specific data based on the documented security decisions.

Current:
> v5.0.0-14.2.3 Verify that defined sensitive data is not sent to untrusted parties (e.g., user trackers) to prevent unwanted collection of data outside of the application's control.

Proposal (for verifying the idea, the wording needs improvements):
> v5.0.0-14.2.3 Verify that defined sensitive data is not sent to untrusted  **or unauthorized** parties (e.g., user trackers) **for that data type** to prevent unwanted collection of data **and sensitive information leakage** outside of the application's control.
